items.title: Widerspruch against rejection of resident parking permit
items.quote: Gegen die Ablehnung können Sie Widerspruch erheben; er muss innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen dieser Bescheid bekannt gegeben wurde, bei der Stadt Musterbüll, Markt 1, 25899 Musterbüll, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift eingehen.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 14.06.2027; no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is stated, so the letter date is the posting day. Sender is a general (non-tax) authority (Stadt Musterbüll), so the 4-day deemed-delivery rule applies but the delivery day does NOT shift off a weekend/holiday. Counting 4 calendar days from 14.06.2027: 15.06 (day1), 16.06 (day2), 17.06 (day3), 18.06.2027 Fri (day4) = deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). One-month Widerspruch period under § 84 SGG/§ 70 VwGO analogue (§§ 187 Abs.2, 188 Abs.2 BGB): the day of delivery (18.06) is not counted as day 1; the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 18.07.2027. 18.07.2027 falls on a Sunday (18.06.2027 is Fri, +30 days = +4 weeks +2 days = Sun). Since the last day is a Sunday, the deadline moves to the next working day under the general rule for objection periods (§ 193 BGB / § 31 Abs.3 VwVfG analogue): Monday 19.07.2027. No SH public holiday intervenes.

items.title: Submit declaration of permanent private use of the vehicle (optional, no deadline given)
items.quote: Reichen Sie diese Erklärung nach, prüfen wir Ihren Antrag gern erneut.
items.computation: The letter invites submission of a declaration that the applicant may permanently use the employer-registered vehicle privately, as an alternative to pursuing the Widerspruch, but states no specific date or period for doing so.
